method: Exact committed-build visual inspection, bbox, solid validity, pairwise interference and clearance; source-parameter interface checks; exported STEP receipt.

unchanged_object_evidence.note: Base, handle and liner source hashes, shape hashes and placements match the previous handoff. Only the shade changed.

visual_review.finding: Forty continuous flutes follow the inward shoulder to the rim, with depth tapering to 0.6 mm at the rim. No broad smooth upper shoulder band remains. Circular inner opening, recessed liner, two magnet locations and lower profile retained.

wire_route.description: Original liner recess retained. Cable exits exposed lamp cup above base rim Z12 and below shade bottom Z32; keep wire out of magnetic mating plane.

limits: No physical printing, cable fit or load test performed.
Straight-section wall range is nominal radial thickness; rounded shoulders and magnet ring are thicker, not constant normal thickness.
Two opposed magnet pairs permit a 180-degree orientation ambiguity; magnet polarity and holding force require assembly testing.
Original lamp voltage, power and connector are unspecified; retain original cable and matched supply.

liner_not_above_shade.evidence: Exact committed-build bounding boxes, top rim plane Z108 and assembled isometric view.

slightly_contracted_upper_opening.evidence: Circular 82.4 mm opening retained; 86–87.2 mm wave outer diameter at rim; final isolated isometric view.

grooves_continue_over_inward_rim.evidence: Isolated isometric and top views of the exact committed build plus nonzero 0.6 mm radial wave depth on the final loft section.
